ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity-to-low intensity ratio; approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels centrally to 20% low-intensity black pixels at the peripheral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity central region. Low-intensity (black) pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and lateral margins. Discrete low-intensity pixel clusters (focal spots) are localized in the medial-lower quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees and deep vertical penetration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary. Right lobe displays higher amplitude peaks (jaggedness) compared to the left lobe medial edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex parabolic curve originating at the median notch and extending symmetrically toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-relief, beige-toned circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized exclusively at the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast grey-scale linear markings visible in the high-intensity central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch/indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe distal section, indicating mechanical trauma. Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal lobe tips.
